_comment: English twin of data/ru/channels_ai.json. Agents = cards over Channel+AIAgent (ADR-HUB-0041 §4). Connections are dialog entry points; the LLM provider is shared across the organization (BYOK). There are two web widgets: the anonymous one on the site (agent «Consultant») and the authenticated one in the customer account (agent «Site support», mandatory-identity policy — SPEC-HUB-0027 P4/P5). The demo LLM provider is the built-in «Demo provider» (no key): agents answer from the knowledge base straight after installation.

agents.name: Consultant
agents.persona: You are a consultant at Nord Atelier. The atelier makes curtains, voile and home textiles to measure and delivers across the country.
agents.tone: Friendly, brief, no officialese. Use the client's name if they have given it.
agents.instructions: Answer only from the atelier's knowledge. Quote lead times, prices and order status only from the knowledge base; if there is no answer, say you will check with colleagues and hand the dialog to a member of staff. Do not promise discounts. If the client asks for a human, hand the dialog over straight away.

agents.name: Site support
agents.persona: You are the support assistant for the Nord Atelier website: accounts, orders, payment, delivery, returns.
agents.instructions: Check the knowledge about accounts and returns first. For questions about a specific order with no order number, ask for the number. Complaints about quality go to a member of staff with a note.

agents.name: Customer account
agents.persona: You are the assistant for the Nord Atelier customer account: orders, payment, statuses, delivery, returns.
agents.instructions: Rely on the knowledge about accounts and orders. Ask for the order number if it has not been given. Complaints about payment go to a member of staff.

knowledge.title: Quoting for made-to-measure curtains
knowledge.description: The pricing formula, fullness ratios, minimum order
knowledge.content:
Price = fabric (metres × price per metre) + making (by the finished width) + hardware.

Fullness ratio: 1.5 for heavy curtains, 2.0–2.5 for voile. Fabric width including fullness = track width × ratio.

Making: £18 per linear metre of finished width for curtains, £14 for voile. The bottom hem is included. Eyelets — £3.50 each, heading tape — £4.80 per metre.

Minimum order — £120. The consultant quotes from the window width and drop; a measuring visit within London is free on orders over £600.

knowledge.title: Fabric catalogue 2026
knowledge.description: Curtain and voile fabrics in stock, prices per metre
knowledge.content:
Curtain fabrics: Nord blackout (100% blackout, £59/m, 14 colours), linen blend (£35/m, 9 colours), Verona velvet (£87/m, 6 colours), canvas (£27/m, 12 colours).

Voile: sheer voile (£15/m), Greek net (£20/m), linen voile (£29/m).

Every fabric is 280–300 cm wide. We post samples free of charge — up to 5 of them.

knowledge.title: How to measure your windows yourself
knowledge.content:
1. Measure the length of the track from end to end (not the window!).
2. Measure the drop from the track hook (or the top of the pole) to the length you want: to the sill (minus 1 cm), to the floor (minus 1–2 cm) or puddled on the floor (+3–5 cm).
3. For eyelet curtains add 3 cm at the top.
4. Photograph the whole window — a consultant will check the figures.

knowledge.title: Making times and delivery
knowledge.description: Making 5–7 working days, delivery by DPD and courier
knowledge.content:
Making takes 5–7 working days once the quote is agreed and paid. Express making (3 working days) costs +30% of the making price and only if the fabric is in stock.

Delivery: within London by courier £15 (free over £400), slots 10:00–13:00, 13:00–17:00, 17:00–20:00; the courier calls an hour ahead. Across the country — DPD to a pickup point or to your door, 3–5 working days from dispatch, and the tracking number arrives by e-mail on the day of dispatch. Manchester, Birmingham and Leeds are usually 3 days.

Moving a delivery slot is free of charge, no later than 18:00 the day before.

knowledge.title: Returns and exchanges
knowledge.description: 14 days, and the terms for made-to-measure items
knowledge.content:
Ready-made items (cushions, throws from the catalogue) — returnable within 14 days with no reason given, provided they have not been used.

Items made to your own measurements cannot be returned (bespoke goods are exempt from the cancellation right under the Consumer Contracts Regulations), except where they are faulty or do not match the agreed order: wrong colour or size, defects in the making. In that case we remake them free of charge or exchange them for another colour in stock, in 5–7 working days; if the client prefers, we refund the money within 10 days.

A claim needs the order number and photographs of the item. The claim is raised by a member of staff, not by the AI.

knowledge.title: Caring for your curtains
knowledge.description: Washing, ironing and cleaning by fabric type
knowledge.content: Blackout: delicate wash at 30°, no spin, iron on the reverse at the lowest temperature. Linen: wash at 40°, shrinkage of up to 3% is allowed for in the measurements. Velvet: dry clean only. Voile: wash at 30° in a mesh bag, dry it on the track.

knowledge.title: The customer account on the website
knowledge.content:
You sign in with your e-mail. The password reset message comes from no-reply@nord-atelier.com within 5 minutes; if it has not arrived, check your spam folder and that the address is right. You can ask for another one after 10 minutes.

Order statuses in the account: “Awaiting payment” → “In production” → “Ready” → “Handed to the courier” → “Delivered”. The delivery address can be changed up to the “Handed to the courier” status — through a support agent.
